integrity: The mathematical claim is proved analytically. Reproducible scripts provide finite exact and numerical checks, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordinary binary Hamming codes of length \(2^m-1\), with \(m\ge2\), in the standard Euclidean cube embedding; not to arbitrary codes or individual-check LP relaxations. Independent validation is not performed; historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact Euclidean cube-to-Hamming-code-polytope distance and its simplex projection faces
